title: Refund and dispute policy
description: How Farmkeke protects your payment, what happens if a farm doesn't accept, how to report a problem, and how refunds are paid.
short: **In short:** you pay through Paystack only after the farm accepts your order. If something is wrong with it, report it within 24 hours of delivery or collection, and we'll refund you.

blocks.p: Payments are made through Paystack, a licensed payment company. You pay only after the farm has accepted your order, and Paystack passes each farm its share of your payment directly.

If your order arrives damaged, incomplete, wrong or not as described, report it within **24 hours** of delivery or collection, and Farmkeke refunds you for what went wrong, even when the farm has already been paid. Pickup orders wait at the farm for 3 days once they are ready.

sections.title: If the farm does not accept

blocks.p: Each farm has 24 hours to accept your order. You pay only after it accepts: we then send you one bill by email, text and in the app, with the delivery fee included for home delivery. If the farm declines or does not respond in time, the order is cancelled and you pay nothing. If you do not pay your bill within 12 hours, the order is cancelled and you are not charged.
If your order is damaged, incomplete, wrong or not as described, report it from your order page within **24 hours** of delivery or collection. Please include:

ul: which items were affected, and how many
a short description of what went wrong

blocks.p: After 24 hours the order closes and can no longer be reported from the order page, but you can still contact support.

The farm has 12 hours to reply to your report. Farmkeke then reviews the photos, messages and delivery records, and usually makes a decision within one day. We will tell you the outcome by email and in the app.

ul: **Full refund** if the whole order is affected, or it never reached you.
**Part refund** for the affected items only.
**No refund** if the order arrived as described.
The delivery fee is not refunded for a part refund, because the delivery took place.

blocks.p: Refunds go back to the card or bank account you paid with, through Paystack, against your original payment. Banks usually show a refund within 3 to 10 working days. You can track it on your order page using the refund reference.
Farmkeke pays your refund straight away and settles anything the farm owes with the farm separately, so you never wait for the farm.
Only payments made through Farmkeke are protected. If a farmer asks you to pay them directly or in cash, please refuse and report it to [support@farmkeke.com](mailto:support@farmkeke.com).
